$comment: SS-131 demo catalog — representative product snapshot of sabzsistem.com (titles/models/brands as listed on the live WooCommerce site, Sep 2026). Photos are the live product images (see SOURCES.md), normalized to ≤1024px JPEG and committed under images/. Prices: the live site displays Rial; the storefront contract is Toman, so priceToman = priceRial / 10 (the seeder asserts this invariant). Prices marked (est.) were hidden on the live site (call-for-price) and are plausible current-market values. The live site has no downloadable product videos, so the video-bearing product uses a generated demo clip to exercise the gallery video path. Slugs are unique ASCII kebab-case ≤200 chars. Every product is PUBLISHED with a primary image; seed-halo-beam is multi-variant (priceFrom path); seed-pdxv40 carries a video; seed-lint-remover has zero stock (out-of-stock path).
